children: said on Tuesday it had filed a notification with prosecutors over alleged safety breaches during the 2023 launch of its flagship Polimery Police project.

The state-controlled company said in a statement that the Polimery Police plant, operated by an Azoty unit, was started without the required permits and in conditions that could have endangered employees and local residents.
